---
name: storybook-vitest
description: Storybook 10 stories and Vitest component tests. Use when adding stories or component tests.
---
- Stories in `src/stories/<Name>.stories.ts`.
- Mock APIs with `msw-storybook-addon`.
- Run: `npm run test:storybook`.
- Cover default, empty, loading, error states.
- Keep a11y addon clean.
